title: Exponents & Powers
description: Class 7 IMO — Exponents & Powers: the laws of exponents, negative exponents, and writing large and small numbers in standard (scientific) form.

topics.title: Laws of Exponents
topics.concept:
An exponent tells how many times to multiply a number (the base) by itself.

5 x 5 x 5 = 5^3 (read as '5 to the power of 3' or '5 cubed')

TermMeaningExample
BaseThe number being multiplied5
ExponentHow many times to multiply3
PowerThe whole expression5^3 = 125

Special cases:

  • a^1 = a (any number to power 1 is itself)
  • a^0 = 1 (any nonzero number to power 0 is 1)
  • 1^n = 1 (one raised to any power is 1)
EXPONENTIAL GROWTH:
  2^1 = 2    **
  2^2 = 4    ****
  2^3 = 8    ********
  2^4 = 16   ****************

LAWS OF EXPONENTS:
  Same base, multiply: a^m x a^n = a^(m+n)
  Same base, divide:   a^m / a^n = a^(m-n)
  Power of power:      (a^m)^n   = a^(m*n)

examples.problem: Write 7 x 7 x 7 x 7 using exponents.

recap: aᵐ × aⁿ = aᵐ⁺ⁿ; aᵐ ÷ aⁿ = aᵐ⁻ⁿ; (aᵐ)ⁿ = aᵐⁿ.
Exponent = how many times the base is multiplied by itself
a^m x a^n = a^(m+n) when bases are the same

quiz.explanation: Any non-zero number to the power 0 is 1.

topics.title: Negative Exponents
topics.concept:
Negative bases with exponents: Parentheses make a critical difference!

ExpressionMeaningResult
(-2)^4(-2) x (-2) x (-2) x (-2)+16 (positive)
-2^4-(2 x 2 x 2 x 2)-16 (negative)

Key rule: Even exponent on a negative base gives a positive result. Odd exponent on a negative base gives a negative result.

Order of Operations (PEMDAS):

  1. Parentheses
  2. Exponents
  3. Multiplication and Division (left to right)
  4. Addition and Subtraction (left to right)
ORDER OF OPERATIONS PYRAMID:

        [Parentheses]    (highest priority)
        [Exponents    ]
        [x or /       ]
        [+ or -       ]  (lowest priority)

NEGATIVE BASE RULE:
  Even exponent: (-3)^4 = +81  (positive)
  Odd exponent:  (-3)^3 = -27  (negative)

examples.solution: (-3)^3 = (-3) x (-3) x (-3) = -27. Also -3^3 = -(3x3x3) = -27. Same result because exponent is odd.
Exponents first: 4^2=16. Then multiply: 16 x 2=32. Then add: 3+32=35.

recap: Even exponent on negative base gives positive result
Odd exponent on negative base gives negative result
Parentheses change the meaning: (-2)^4 is different from -2^4
Always apply PEMDAS: Parentheses, Exponents, Multiply/Divide, Add/Subtract

topics.title: Standard Form (Scientific Notation)
topics.concept: Standard form writes a number as a × 10ⁿ, where 1 ≤ a < 10. Large numbers use positive powers (45000 = 4.5 × 10⁴) and small numbers use negative powers (0.0006 = 6 × 10⁻⁴).
recap: Large numbers → positive power; small numbers → negative power.

quiz.q: What is 5 × 10³ as an ordinary number?

questions.q: aᵐ × aⁿ equals a to the power ___ ?
questions.explanation: When multiplying powers of the same base, add the exponents.
A negative exponent gives the reciprocal: a⁻ⁿ = 1/aⁿ.
Any non-zero number to the power 0 is 1.
A power of a power multiplies the exponents.

questions.q: What is 6 × 10³ as an ordinary number?
